top_signals.title: US 10-Year Yield Set for Historic Run Above 5% on Fed Rate Cycle
top_signals.summary: The US’s 10-year Treasury yield is nearing its longest run above 5% in almost two decades as investors position for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates more amid stubbornly elevated inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Gulf Oil Flow at Risk From Lack of Empty Tankers, Tracker Says
top_signals.summary: The number of empty tankers sailing to collect cargoes of Middle East crude is sliding, a trend that could jeopardize the recent revival in the region’s oil flows to global markets, according to Tankertrackers.com, a firm that monitors vessel movements.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Is China Misreading the Moment?
top_signals.summary: When U.S. President Donald Trump lands in Shenzhen later this week for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, he will sit down with Chinese leader Xi Jinping for the fourth time amid an unexpected détente between Washington and Beijing. The trade war of 2025 is in abeyance, the two governments have announced a relationship of “constructive strategic stability,” and, to the alarm of American allies, Trump and Xi are planning to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Beneath the surface, however, the détente is beginning to crack.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hammack Says Fed Should Set High Bar for Market Interventions
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack says policymakers should establish principles for when and how to intervene in Treasury markets during an event at the Brookings Institution in Washington, D.C.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Jensen Huang to appear before House panels Dec. 1; Nvidia lawyer slated to testify Dec. 2
top_signals.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after revelations he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Lucky Strike CEO Makes Take-Private Offer as Loan Hits Distress
top_signals.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment Corp. founder Thomas Shannon has proposed taking the company private after a bruising stretch in which its shares hit a record low and its debt fell into distressed territory.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Kazakhstan Unveils $85 Million Oil and Gas Manufacturing Push
top_signals.summary: Kazakhstan expects to launch 15 projects to manufacture goods for the oil and gas sector in a plan worth $84.7 million (37.7 billion Kazakh tenge), Energy Minister Yerlan Akkenzhenov said on Tuesday. “These projects will create new jobs and help Kazakhstan develop domestic manufacturing expertise, enabling the production of higher-value goods,” Akkenzhenov said at a government meeting, as carried by Kazakhstan’s Qazinform News Agency. Following the launch of 10 local manufacturing sites for the oil and gas supply chain between…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Disney Tops Profit Estimates on Streaming TV Growth
top_signals.summary: Disney saw sales and earnings that exceeded analysts’ expectations in the fourth quarter, led by a particularly strong result in its streaming TV unit. Geetha Ranganathan of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Serco launches High Court claim against Ministry of Justice
top_signals.summary: London-listed outsourcing group Serco has launched fresh legal action against the Ministry of Justice (MoJ). The group, using law firm CMS, filed a procurement claim against the government body with the High Court’s Technology and Construction Court on Friday, according to filings. The subject of the case is not known, and Serco declined to comment. [...]
